1-1.text: Part one. What is a ratio? ... A ratio compares two or more amounts. This bag has 4 red sweets and 3 green sweets.

1-2.text: We write red to green as 4 to 3, and we say it as 4 to 3. The order matters: green to red is 3 to 4.

1-3.text: There are 4 plus 3, which is 7 sweets altogether. So four sevenths of the sweets are red and three sevenths are green.

2-1.text: Part two. Equivalent ratios and simplest form. ... Multiply both parts by the same number and you get an equivalent ratio. 1 to 4 is the same as 2 to 8 and 3 to 12.

2-2.text: To simplify a ratio, divide both parts by a number that goes into both. 8 to 12, divided by 4, is 2 to 3.

2-3.text: When no whole number except 1 goes into all the parts, the ratio is in its simplest form. It works for three parts too: 12 to 18 to 30, divided by 6, is 2 to 3 to 5.

3-1.text: Part three. Sharing in a ratio. ... Mia and Leo share 35 pounds in the ratio 2 to 5. First add the parts: 2 plus 5 is 7 parts.

3-2.text: Next find what one part is worth: 35 pounds divided by 7 is 5 pounds.

3-3.text: Mia gets 2 parts: 2 times 5 pounds is 10 pounds. Leo gets 5 parts: 5 times 5 pounds is 25 pounds. Check: 10 pounds plus 25 pounds is 35 pounds.

3-4.text: Sometimes you know one share. Squash and water are mixed 2 to 5, with 60 millilitres of squash. 2 parts are 60 millilitres, so 1 part is 30 millilitres, and the water is 5 times 30, which is 150 millilitres.

4-1.text: Part four. Proportion and best buys. ... Two amounts are in direct proportion when they grow together: if one doubles, so does the other. 3 rubbers cost 45 pence.

4-2.text: Find the cost of one first. 1 rubber costs 45 divided by 3, which is 15 pence. Then 5 rubbers cost 5 times 15, which is 75 pence.

4-3.text: Recipes work the same way. A recipe for 4 people uses 300 grams of flour. 1 person needs 300 divided by 4, which is 75 grams, so 6 people need 6 times 75, which is 450 grams.

4-4.text: Best buys: compare the price of the same amount. 400 grams for 2 pounds is 50 pence per 100 grams. 300 grams for 1 pound 80 is 60 pence per 100 grams. So the 400 gram pack is better value.

4-5.text: Inverse proportion: more workers means less time. 3 builders take 8 days to build a wall. 1 builder would take 3 times 8, which is 24 days, so 4 builders take 24 divided by 4, which is 6 days.

5-1.text: Part five. Maps and scales. ... A scale links a map to real life. A scale of 1 to 25 thousand means 1 centimetre on the map is 25 thousand centimetres in real life.

5-2.text: The school and the park are 4 centimetres apart on the map. In real life that is 4 times 25 thousand, which is 100 thousand centimetres.

5-3.text: Now change the units. 100 centimetres make 1 metre, so 100 thousand centimetres is 1000 metres. And 1000 metres is 1 kilometre. The real distance is 1 kilometre.

5-4.text: Models use scales too. A model boat is made to a scale of 1 to 30. The model is 15 centimetres long, so the real boat is 15 times 30, which is 450 centimetres long. That is 4.5 metres.
